cases.meaning: The plan has a POS option for outside-network providers at additional cost; Chapter 3 Section 2.3 supplies conditions. Do not turn the HMO label into a prohibition of all OON care.
cases.name: plan_nature

cases.meaning: Retain the network/full-cost wording, listed emergency/urgent/dialysis/authorized exceptions and the complete POS paragraph continuing onto page 9: certain services, generally higher sharing and possible other restrictions.
cases.name: directory_continuation

cases.meaning: PCP oversight and recommended notification/coordination are distinct from a required PCP referral or hospital admission order.
cases.name: pcp_coordination

cases.meaning: The explicit no-PCP-referral statement is for network specialists or behavioral/mental-health providers; do not broaden it automatically to every service or admission.
cases.name: specialist_referral

cases.meaning: OON chart sharing applies even with referral or pre-visit decision. If no contracted provider is available, member may ask to access OON care at IN sharing; this is conditional, not a general cost conversion.
cases.name: oon_cost

cases.meaning: When an IN provider or benefit is unavailable or inadequate to meet medical needs, the plan arranges medically necessary covered care OON at IN sharing. Preserve all antecedents and the plan-arranged route.
cases.name: network_unavailable

cases.meaning: OON choice requires covered benefits and medical necessity; noncontracted providers generally have no duty to treat except emergencies. Medicare participation eligibility and opted-out/excluded/precluded provider limits remain, with the emergency exception.
cases.name: pos_provider_eligibility

cases.meaning: Explicit no-referral/no-PA OON statement retains the pre-visit coverage-decision advice, possible denial/entire-cost liability for uncovered or unnecessary services, and appeal rights.
cases.name: pos_referral_pa

cases.meaning: Preserve the 50 states/DC POS scope, no-territories statement, its complete printed parenthetical emergency/post-stabilization/dialysis/urgent exceptions and certain-services/network-only qualifications. Do not silently expand territories or worldwide routine POS.
cases.name: pos_geography

cases.meaning: Preserve provider-bill-plan recommendation, reimbursement after member payment and sending an unpaid bill to the plan as distinct routes; do not require advance payment for all payment requests.
cases.name: payment_route

cases.meaning: Emergency care does not require initial PCP approval/referral or a network doctor; the prudent-layperson belief and harm scope, worldwide emergency route and provider determination of stabilization remain.
cases.name: emergency_access

cases.meaning: Generic US OON follow-up higher sharing and the authorized OON inpatient after-stabilization IN-sharing exception retain their distinct scopes. Authorization AND after-stabilization must remain together; not every OON stay receives IN sharing.
cases.name: poststabilization

cases.meaning: Foreign emergency coverage stays limited to immediate emergency/stabilization. Post-stabilization care beyond that must be in the US to be eligible; repatriation and preplanned foreign services exclusions remain. Preserve source wording rather than inventing coverage.
cases.name: foreign_stabilization

cases.meaning: Urgent service scope retains temporary out-of-area OR unreasonable given time/place/circumstances to obtain network care, routine-visit exclusion and the complete foreign continuation.
cases.name: urgent

cases.meaning: Declared-disaster authorities and geographic predicate remain. OON at IN sharing requires inability to use a network provider during the disaster; it is not every ordinary OON visit.
cases.name: disaster

cases.meaning: Retain OON-without-authorization full-cost and generic network/referral language alongside explicit POS no-referral/no-PA and Chapter 4 no-advance-approval statements. Any proposed relationship needs exact source-based applicability reasoning; a generic precedence convention alone is insufficient.
cases.name: full_cost_tension

cases.meaning: IN authorization is attached to some chart services and MAY/double-dagger scope; preserve provider responsibility, no advance OON approval, optional advance coverage decision and valid course-of-treatment duration criteria.
cases.name: chart_authorization

cases.meaning: Minimum 90-day no-PA transition applies to a new enrollee active treatment course, including a course commenced with OON provider. It is not a generic annual PA waiver for all care.
cases.name: transition

cases.meaning: Any discussion of trial no-plan/PCP-permission or network exception preserves Medicare-approved study scope, NCD-CED/IDE benefit exception and possible PA/other plan rules. No waiver is imported into ordinary inpatient care.
cases.name: clinical_trial_exception

cases.meaning: Formal physician admission order, discharge-day boundary and observation distinction are not referral or plan authorization. Admission/facility-type reset, transplant-network limits and nominal chart sharing remain separate.
cases.name: inpatient_order

cases.meaning: SB nationwide Medicare-accepting provider summary and possible higher OON sharing retain certain-services limitation and EOC detail. No participation or coverage for an actual provider is established.
cases.name: sb_scope

cases.meaning: Exact flat inpatient referral question/No is a distinct source-format result. Do not decode native raw 2 or turn a physician order, generic network condition or source silence into a matching referral predicate.
cases.name: flat_native_boundary

cases.meaning: Bind each source rule and continuation to exact original IDs, roles, original hashes/states and precise source regions/words. Broad contextual overlap or page membership is not whole-original equivalence.
cases.name: lineage

cases.meaning: Any remaining r3 referral unknown must receive a specific disposition and remaining action. No favorable whole-original outcome, source acceptance, canonical adoption, current provider/network verification or app/database integration follows from this review.
cases.name: output_scope
